story:
GARP Construction Group Inc. is a general contractor based in Miami, Florida, serving Miami-Dade and Southeast Florida. The company was incorporated in 2011 and has been building here since 2012, bringing over fifteen years of combined experience and a reputation for quality and client satisfaction in home improvement and design. Renovations, remodeling and maintenance are our specialties, with a focus on never sacrificing quality because of the size or scope of a project.

What makes the company unusual is the licensing. Most general contractors in South Florida hold a GC license and subcontract the rest. GARP holds four separate Florida state certifications — Certified General Contractor (CGC1520370), Certified Roofing Contractor (CCC1329807), Certified Air Conditioning Contractor (CAC1817062) and Certified Plumbing Contractor (CFC1429344). On a job that needs more than one of those trades, that is the difference between one contract and one schedule, and three companies working around each other.

As a general contractor we are responsible for the materials, labor, equipment and services a project needs. Working from your architectural drawings we sequence the specialist trades, manage the work, and are accountable for finishing on time, on budget and to the standard we quoted. We take great pride in our ability to understand our own capabilities and not promise more than we can deliver — which is what yields satisfied clients and projects that finish properly. Commercial or residential, we work closely with you to build the home or the space you actually asked for, and we manage projects throughout Southeast Florida from our Miami office.
